description: This file defines the 'FedexServices' class which provides methods to interact with FedEx's shipment API, including sending requests, handling subscription and shipment requests, and processing replies. It manages the configuration, generates XML requests through templates, and communicates with FedEx servers via HTTP, supporting FedEx's API functionalities such as shipment creation and subscription.

classes.name: FedexServices
classes.description: Provides static methods to facilitate FedEx API interactions such as requesting shipments, handling subscriptions, processing responses, and managing configuration parameters.

methods.name: sendFedexRequest
methods.description: Sends an XML request to Fedex's API endpoint via HTTP POST and returns the received XML response as a string.

methods.name: fedexSubscriptionRequest
methods.description: Handles the registration of a Fedex account by sending a subscription request, returning the meter number if successful.

methods.name: fedexShipRequest
methods.description: Constructs and sends a shipment request to Fedex, handling package details, addresses, and shipment options, and processing the reply.

methods.name: handleFedexShipReply
methods.description: Extracts tracking number and shipping label from the FedEx reply XML, decodes label image, updates shipment package segment records, and handles errors.

methods.name: handleErrors
methods.description: Analyzes XML elements for errors, collects error messages, and adds them to the error list for further processing.

methods.name: getShipmentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves configuration values for a shipment gateway, either from the database or properties files.

methods.name: getShipmentGatewayConfigValue (overloaded)
methods.description: Retrieves configuration value with default fallback.
